story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Sakhi Business Consulting was founded with a simple purpose — to make business compliance easier for Indian entrepreneurs. Running a business already comes with enough challenges, and complex regulations, government paperwork, registrations, renewals, and tax compliance can take valuable time away from what entrepreneurs do best — building and growing their businesses.

That's where we come in. From Shop Act registrations and GST compliance to FSSAI licenses and import-export documentation, we help businesses manage the essential requirements that keep them compliant and ready to grow.

Our approach is simple: understand your requirement, guide you through the process, handle the paperwork, and keep you informed at every step. You focus on your business — we take care of the compliance.
